preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1,000, inclusive.
The range of integers L to R is within the constraints of the task.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(goodness(i) for i in range(L, R+1)) % 1000000007
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the goodness of all integers from L to R, inclusive, modulo 1,000,000,007.
